question: At the qualified R17 actual-108 state, what is the first nested phase-anchor cardinality in {1,2,4,8,16} for which every phase-plus-one-derived-coordinate projection reproduces the full five-coordinate nine-entity class membership?
hypothesis: The R15-R17 necessity result reflects missing phase partition information rather than a requirement for all sixteen exact phase values. Cardinality 1 will fail in all four derived-coordinate panels, at least one preregistered coarsened cardinality in {2,4,8} will reproduce full-five-coordinate membership in all four panels, and every larger nested cardinality will remain fully matched through the exact-cardinality-16 control.

prior_evidence.observation: The complete fixed width-two panel qualified after four phase-plus-derived controls reproduced full-five-coordinate membership and the six derived-only pairs were classified by the frozen R17 rules. R15 had already shown that omitting phase from the full derived-coordinate tuple leaves a structural cross-entity collision.

scope_statement: This changes one dimension from R16-R17: the phase coordinate is deterministically coarsened through a fixed nested cardinality sweep while tuple width remains two and each of the four derived coordinates is evaluated. Actual-108 records, streams, seeds, budget, exact set equality, capacity, induction, and evaluator-only audit remain fixed. It makes no population, task-learning, natural-language, or deployment claim.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, live-interface, CKB-plane, or cross-lane authority

arms_and_inputs.full_five_coordinate_control: Exact R17 actual-108 records represented by sorted exact sets of [phase_anchor,prefix0,prefix1,suffix0,suffix1].
arms_and_inputs.r17_exact_pair_controls: Exactly four projections [phase_anchor,prefix0], [phase_anchor,prefix1], [phase_anchor,suffix0], [phase_anchor,suffix1] using the unmodified 160..175 phase byte.
arms_and_inputs.coarsening_rule: For source phase byte p in 160..175 and cardinality k, projected_phase = floor((p-160)*k/16). This creates nested equal-width partitions; k=1 removes phase identity and k=16 is byte-equivalent up to relabeling.
arms_and_inputs.resolution_panel: For each cardinality in ascending order, evaluate exactly four width-two projections [projected_phase,prefix0], [projected_phase,prefix1], [projected_phase,suffix0], [projected_phase,suffix1], for exactly twenty arms total. Every arm uses identical actual-108 records; no source byte is mutated.
arms_and_inputs.evaluation: Exact projected-support equality, class cardinality, class-membership comparison, and evaluator-only entity audit; no task model is trained.

seeds.all_arms: Exact R6-R17 independent seeds; phase projection introduces no random draw.

controls: The local deterministic R17 probe must reproduce its frozen classification and controls before R18 output.
The full five-coordinate control must reproduce nine correct triplets with zero splits and zero cross-entity collisions.
All four unmodified phase-plus-derived R17 controls must exactly reproduce full-five-coordinate membership.
Cardinality 1 must be identical to derived-coordinate-only support for each corresponding derived coordinate and match none of the four full-five-coordinate memberships.
Cardinality 16 must be a bijective relabeling of exact phase and all four arms must match their unmodified R17 controls.
The complete five-by-four resolution matrix runs once in declared order; entity and family labels are unavailable to projection and induction and enter only the post-induction audit.
validity_criteria: Exact parent and North Star identities match.
The local deterministic R17 probe reproduces its frozen controls and classification before R18 output.
All twenty projections are constructed from identical actual-108 records with exactly one projected phase coordinate and one declared derived coordinate.
The cardinality list is exactly [1,2,4,8,16]; projected phase values are in 0..k-1; the partitions are nested; and reconstruction independently matches floor((p-160)*k/16).
Every arm has frozen cardinality, valid byte ranges, finite metrics, and exactly 36 unordered entity pairs audited.
Full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, task training, external model, network call, capacity growth, fuzzy matching, seed search, adaptive arm selection, or evaluator leakage occurs.

classification_rules.coarsened_phase_resolution_supported: Validity and controls pass; cardinality 1 fails all four panels, at least one of {2,4,8} matches full-five-coordinate membership in all four panels, and all larger cardinalities remain matched.
classification_rules.exact_phase_resolution_required: Validity and controls pass; 16 is the first cardinality matching full-five-coordinate membership in all four panels, with no post-onset failure.
classification_rules.derived_specific_resolution: Validity and controls pass, but no single cardinality below 16 matches all four panels even though at least one below-16 arm matches, or the first successful cardinality differs by derived coordinate.
classification_rules.nonmonotone: Validity and controls pass, but any larger cardinality fails an all-four match after onset.
classification_rules.negative_control_failure: Any frozen R17, full-five-coordinate, cardinality-1, or cardinality-16 control fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the complete fixed twenty-arm panel.
classification_rules.invalid: Any identity, construction, arm-cardinality, projection, nesting, leakage, evaluator-boundary, determinism, finite-metric, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on identity, R17 replication, full-five-coordinate control, exact-pair control, construction, build, or frozen-package drift.
After R18 output begins, complete all twenty resolution arms and frozen evaluations unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not add cardinalities, alter the coarsening rule, inspect alternate budgets, or change controls, metrics, thresholds, capacity, or classification after observing R18 output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No arm, phase cardinality, coarsening rule, derived coordinate, budget, context distribution, sample sequence, seed, representation rule, class learner, control, metric, threshold, capacity, stop condition, or interpretation may change after primary R18 output.
